AA · test T10 · results page generated by tests/T10/report.py from evidence/headline/

Does holding the whole parent while FS ≥ 0.60 beat holding the parent, or the three-index switch?

T10 · IN PROGRESS · run headline · data as of 2026-11-12 · window 2019-01-02 to 2026-10-30

The question. Does holding the whole parent while the weekly FS score is at least 0.60 (segment_v2's production rule) do better, after cost, than holding the parent, or than the three-index switch, on the latest approved data? FS = the share (by count) of the stocks the parent holds whose Large / Mid / Small-and-below band has a BUY supertrend (Nifty 100 / Midcap 100 / Smallcap 100). Below 0.60 the book holds 50% GOLDBEES and 50% cash.

There is no null and no random draws in the four criteria (Manu waived it, 2026-11-12): no chance benchmark was run. Nothing on this page says the rule beats chance, and no finding from this test is stronger than PROVISIONAL.

Verdicts (after cost at 20.8 bps, full window 2019-01-02 to 2026-10-30; each criterion passes if at least 3 of the 4 books pass; the four books share one market, one set of signals and the same weeks of difference, so 3 of 4 is a consistency check):

The tag data and its limits

The weekly tag of every stock comes from the shared tag rule (reviewed 2026-11-12). The caveats of the review, which apply to every number on this page:

  1. the market-cap history to 2025-11-28 was back-filled, so a point-in-time vintage cannot be proven;
  2. the rank rule is untested before 2026-04-09 (91.4% of the parents' holding-weeks use it); its three-band agreement with real membership is 92.07% (Large recall 88.1%, Mid 79.8%, Small and below 96.5%), and on the parents' own holdings 88.9% by weight (SCMO_0003 91.1%, 0007 88.2%, 0010 80.0%, 0029 96.3%);
  3. the source switches on 2026-04-09 and about 8% of stocks differ between the two;
  4. isolated bad market-cap rows exist (LODHA 2021, AXISBANK 2026-10-07);
  5. JSWSTEEL, VEDL, ZEEL, EMBASSY, BIRET and BAGMANE are in no basket to 2026-10-30 and would read by rank in a later one.

T10 reads tags at every weekly decision, not only at events as T07 does.

Share of the weekly tag reads that use the rank rule, full window: SCMO_0003 89.8%, SCMO_0007 92.9%, SCMO_0010 91.7%, SCMO_0029 92.0%.

3 · One decision, end to end (SCMO_0003, decision of 2019-03-08)

One real weekly decision, picked by a stated rule and not for its result: the first week of the full window (2019-01-02 to 2026-10-30) in which the rule is IN, the three-index switch is OUT and the rule trades. Every number is printed from the evidence; the stock prices are from the approved OHLC file (D18). It is decision no. 10 of 410, made at the close of 2019-03-08 (Friday).

The latest non-skipped basket with availableDate on or before 2019-03-08 is the basket of 2018-12-17: 10 stocks with listed weight above zero (weights renormalised to sum to 1, as in T06).

Step 3 · the three signals

The latest Master row of each index on or before the decision date: Nifty 100 SELL (row dated 2019-03-08), Midcap 100 BUY (row dated 2019-03-08), Smallcap 100 BUY (row dated 2019-03-08): pattern SBB.

Step 4 · the FS score and the decision

n = stocks held = 10 (Large 1, Mid 1, Small and below 8) k = stocks whose band is on = 9 FS = k ÷ n = 9 ÷ 10 = 0.900 rule: IN iff 5k ≥ 3n (FS ≥ 0.60 decided in integers): 5 × 9 = 45 against 3 × 10 = 30 → IN switch: IN iff the pattern is BBB; SBB → OUT (an extra week: the rule is IN while the switch is OUT)

FS weighted by the listed weights (0.902) is robustness R6 only; it plays no part in the decision.

Step 5 · the trade

The decision is made at the close of 2019-03-08; the trade is on the next session, 2019-03-11 (session no. 47 of 1,932), at each instrument's OHLC4 = (open + high + low + close) ÷ 4 of that session. The book held OUT (50% GOLDBEES, 50% cash).

V = the book's value at that session's fill prices before cost = 1.007796 (NAV is 1.000 at the close of 2019-01-02) target for stock i = V × w_i; GOLDBEES and cash 0 (so the whole sleeve, 1.007796, is sold and 1.007796 of stocks is bought) traded = Σ |target − current| over stocks, GOLDBEES and cash = 2.015591 cost = traded × 20.8 ÷ 2 ÷ 10,000 = 2.015591 × 0.001040 = 0.002096 every new position is scaled by (V − cost) ÷ V = 0.99792000 units_i = V × w_i × that ÷ OHLC4_i

NAV_t = Σ stock units × close + GOLDBEES units × close + cash units × level, 1.000 at the close of 2019-01-02, 20.8 bps. The switch stays OUT until its own event on 2019-03-18 (state+basket, state after: IN).

Step 7 · the equity curve and its statistics

The rule's path runs 2019-01-02 to 2026-10-30: 1,932 sessions, end NAV 6.6343.

CAGR = end NAV ^ (252 ÷ (sessions − 1)) − 1 = 6.6343 ^ (252 ÷ 1,932 − 1) − 1 = 28.01% max drawdown = min over t of NAV_t ÷ (max NAV up to t) − 1 = -20.17% (peak 4.7480 on 2024-09-30, trough 3.7903 on 2025-01-14)

Step 8 · the comparators on the same path

2019-01-02 to 2026-10-30, 20.8 bps: three-index switch CAGR 28.41%, max drawdown -18.42%; hold the parent CAGR 16.21%, max drawdown -46.32%. No chance benchmark was run.

If any gate fails nothing on this page may be read. All gates passed for this page to be built.

gateresultwhat it checks
V1 independent checkPASSverify_t10.py re-derives decisions, tags, FS, events, NAVs, stretches, bootstrap and R4 draws from the raw files; deliberate corruptions must be detected

V4 the exact factsPASSthe rule is never OUT while the switch is IN; FS = k ÷ n; the state is IN iff 5k ≥ 3n; the float formula's disagreements listed (none expected)

8 · Definitions

Weekly decision: T0, then the last session of each ISO week; trade on the next session at OHLC4; the last decision (2026-10-30) is made but not traded. Band of a stock: Large / Mid / Small and below, from the shared tag rule as of the decision date. A band is on if its index (Nifty 100 / Midcap 100 / Smallcap 100) has SIGN = BUY. FS = k ÷ n, k = stocks whose band is on, n = stocks held (listed weight above zero). Rule: IN iff 5k ≥ 3n; IN holds the whole basket at listed weights (renormalised), OUT holds 50% GOLDBEES + 50% cash. Three-index switch: IN iff all three SIGNs are BUY. Extra week: rule IN and switch OUT. Stretch: a maximal run of extra weeks. Cost: cost_bps ÷ 2 ÷ 10,000 per side on Σ |target − current| over every stock, GOLDBEES and cash; the first position at T0 is free; there is no sale at the end. NAV_t = Σ stock units × close + GOLDBEES units × close + cash units × level, 1.000 at the close of T0. CAGR = end NAV ^ (252 ÷ (sessions − 1)) − 1. Max drawdown = min over t of NAV_t ÷ max(NAV_s, s ≤ t) − 1. Calmar = CAGR ÷ |max drawdown|. Volatility = SD of daily log returns × √252. Ulcer = √(mean over sessions of (100 × drawdown)²). Days ≥ 10% below = sessions with NAV at least 10% under its running peak. Longest underwater = longest run of sessions below the previous peak. Constant mix: the rule's average share of NAV in the parent's stocks, f, held all the time (f in the parent at listed weights, half of 1 − f in GOLDBEES, half in cash), rebalanced at each of the rule's event sessions at OHLC4 with the same cost. C1: rule CAGR > parent CAGR. C2: rule max drawdown shallower than the parent's. C3: rule CAGR > switch CAGR. C4: rule Calmar ≥ switch Calmar. Each: at least 3 of 4 books. C3 and C4 only where the rule has at least 5 separate stretches of extra weeks. Bootstrap: daily log-return difference (rule − comparator) resampled in moving blocks of 20 sessions, 1,000 resamples; interval = 2.5th and 97.5th percentile of the CAGR difference. R4: each rank-sourced tag replaced with probability 0.0793 by one of the other two bands; the rule re-run on the perturbed tags (no null, no pass mark).

What this page cannot say

With no random benchmark, a better number is a difference on this window, not proof of skill. The negative control and the oracle (which need a null) were not run, so the pipeline's ability to detect an edge is untested. The rule's family and this window have been seen (Studies 2 and 3, T03 to T08, the AA live record); the threshold 0.60 is production's and was not tuned. FS here reads Nifty 100, Midcap 100 and Smallcap 100, not production's Midcap 150 and Smallcap 250 (no approved signals). About 91% of holding-weeks are tagged by the rank rule, which is untested before 2026-04-09. The decisions before 2021-11 are a production backfill. The cash file's source before 2026-08-10 is unrecorded and its extension runs about 0.5 pp a year rich. The window ends inside the last approved basket.
